---
title: "Exam Data Preparation"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

# Data Sources from OWID

```{r}
#| message: false

# Trade openness (trade as % of GDP)
trade <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/trade-as-share-of-gdp.csv")

# GDP per capita (World Bank)
gdppc <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/gdp-per-capita-worldbank.csv")

# Population
pop <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/population.csv")

# Labour productivity (GDP per hour worked)
productivity <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/labor-productivity-per-hour-pennworldtable.csv")

# Potential confounders
schooling <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/mean-years-of-schooling-long-run.csv")
democracy <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/electoral-democracy-index.csv")
urban <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/share-of-population-urban.csv")
life_exp <- read_csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy.csv")
```

# Clean and merge

```{r}
# Helper function to filter to countries only (3-letter codes)
filter_countries <- function(df) {
  df |> filter(str_length(Code) == 3 & !is.na(Code))
}

# Clean main variables (2019 cross-section)
trade_clean <- trade |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(country = Entity, code = Code, year = Year,
         trade_openness = `Trade (% of GDP)`)

gdppc_clean <- gdppc |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(code = Code, gdp_per_capita = `GDP per capita`)

pop_clean <- pop |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(code = Code, population = Population)

prod_clean <- productivity |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(code = Code, labour_productivity = `Productivity: output per hour worked`)

# Clean confounders
schooling_clean <- schooling |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019 | Year == 2020) |>
  group_by(Code) |>
  slice_max(Year) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(code = Code, schooling = `Average years of schooling`)

democracy_clean <- democracy |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(code = Code, democracy = `Electoral Democracy Index`,
         region = `World region according to OWID`)

urban_clean <- urban |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(code = Code, urban_pct = `Urban population (% of total population)`)

life_exp_clean <- life_exp |>
  filter_countries() |>
  filter(Year == 2019) |>
  select(code = Code, life_expectancy = `Life expectancy`)
```

# Merge all datasets

```{r}
df <- trade_clean |>
  left_join(gdppc_clean, by = "code") |>
  left_join(pop_clean, by = "code") |>
  left_join(prod_clean, by = "code") |>
  left_join(schooling_clean, by = "code") |>
  left_join(democracy_clean, by = "code") |>
  left_join(urban_clean, by = "code") |>
  left_join(life_exp_clean, by = "code") |>
  mutate(
    log_gdp_pc = log(gdp_per_capita),
    log_population = log(population),
    log_productivity = log(labour_productivity)
  )

glimpse(df)
```

# Check data availability

```{r}
df |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    trade = sum(!is.na(trade_openness)),
    gdp_pc = sum(!is.na(gdp_per_capita)),
    population = sum(!is.na(population)),
    productivity = sum(!is.na(labour_productivity)),
    schooling = sum(!is.na(schooling)),
    democracy = sum(!is.na(democracy)),
    urban = sum(!is.na(urban_pct)),
    life_exp = sum(!is.na(life_expectancy))
  )
```

# Save datasets

```{r}
# Full dataset with all variables
write_csv(df, "data/trade_exam_enhanced.csv")

# Simplified dataset for students (exam version)
# Choose which confounder to include based on pedagogical goals:
# - Democracy: moderate confounding effect, theoretically interesting
# - Urban %: strong effect, clear mechanism
# - Schooling: very strong effect but fewer observations

df_exam <- df |>
  select(country, code, trade_openness, gdp_per_capita, population,
         urban_pct, democracy, region) |>
  mutate(
    log_gdp_pc = log(gdp_per_capita),
    log_population = log(population)
  )

write_csv(df_exam, "data/trade_exam.csv")
```

# Quick diagnostic: Confounder comparison

```{r}
# Baseline model
m0 <- lm(log_gdp_pc ~ trade_openness, data = df)

# With different confounders
m_pop <- lm(log_gdp_pc ~ trade_openness + log_population, data = df)
m_dem <- lm(log_gdp_pc ~ trade_openness + democracy, data = df)
m_urb <- lm(log_gdp_pc ~ trade_openness + urban_pct, data = df)
m_sch <- lm(log_gdp_pc ~ trade_openness + schooling, data = df)

# Compare coefficients
tibble(
  model = c("Baseline", "+ Population", "+ Democracy", "+ Urban %", "+ Schooling"),
  trade_coef = c(coef(m0)[2], coef(m_pop)[2], coef(m_dem)[2], coef(m_urb)[2], coef(m_sch)[2]),
  r_squared = c(summary(m0)$r.squared, summary(m_pop)$r.squared,
                summary(m_dem)$r.squared, summary(m_urb)$r.squared, summary(m_sch)$r.squared)
) |>
  mutate(
    coef_change_pct = (trade_coef - trade_coef[1]) / trade_coef[1] * 100
  )
```
